title: Language Model Metadata
description: A language model metadata defintion for developer tools

model_id.description: The identifier of the model (example: gpt-3.5-turbo)

model_name.description: The human-friendly name of the model (example: GPT-3.5 Turbo)

model_provider.description: The provider of the model in lowercase (example: openai)

model_description.description: A human-friendly description of the model

model_info.description: Link to a page with more information about the model

context_window.description: The maximum number of tokens in the model's context window

max_tokens.description: The maximum number of tokens the model will use to generate a response

cost_per_million_tokens.description: The model provider's default token pricing in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Provider-specific entries may override this on individual providers.

knowledge_cutoff.description: The training data cutoff date for the model

tokenizer.description: Tokenizer family and specific encoding/version used by the model

tuning.description: Tags for things the model was tuned for (example: function, instruction)

input_type.description: The type of input the model accepts

output_type.description: The type of output the model generates

deprecated.description: Whether the model has been deprecated by the provider

meta_model.description: Whether this entry describes a meta-model (e.g. a router) whose effective context window, pricing, tokenizer, and knowledge cutoff are inherited from whichever underlying model handles a given request. Consumers should treat the declared values as best-effort upper bounds, not guarantees.

providers.description: The providers that serve this model and their configuration

provider_reference.description: A reference to a provider definition

provider_id.description: The identifier matching a provider in providers/

model_id_on_provider.description: The model ID as used by this specific provider (may differ from model_id)

model_info.description: Provider-specific link to this model, such as an aggregator listing or provider docs page

cost_per_million_tokens.description: Provider-specific token pricing in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Use this when an aggregator or route prices the model differently from the primary provider.

token_costs.description: Token pricing in USD per 1,000,000 tokens. Each direction may be a single number or a map of modality-specific prices.

input.description: Input token cost. May be a single blended price or modality-specific prices.

cached_input.description: Cached input token read cost, when the provider exposes separate cache pricing.

cache_write_input.description: Cache write input token cost, when the provider exposes separate cache pricing.

output.description: Output token cost. May be a single blended price or modality-specific prices.

token_cost_value.description: A token price in USD per 1,000,000 tokens, either as one number or split by modality.

modality_costs.description: Modality-specific token prices in USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

text.description: Text token cost in USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

image.description: Image token cost in USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

audio.description: Audio token cost in USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

video.description: Video token cost in USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

other.description: Other or provider-specific token cost in USD per 1,000,000 tokens.

tokenizer_config.description: Tokenizer family and the specific encoding/version identifier within that family

family.description: Tokenizer library or system (example: tiktoken, tekken, sentencepiece)

name.description: The encoding or version identifier within the family (example: 'cl100k_base' for tiktoken, 'v3' for tekken)
